source_dataset: Multilevel Monitoring of Activity and Sleep in Healthy people (MMASH)
target_task: Unsupervised Autonomic Anomaly and Deviation Modeling

features.name: heart_rate
features.description: Mean heart rate in 5-minute window derived from RR intervals (60,000 / mean_nn)

features.name: hrv_rmssd
features.description: Root mean square of successive RR interval differences (parasympathetic modulation)

features.name: hrv_sdnn
features.description: Standard deviation of normal-to-normal intervals (overall autonomic tone)

features.name: pnn50
features.description: Percentage of adjacent intervals differing by > 50 ms

provenance_and_quality.recording_gap_handling: Windows spanning intervals > 5.0 seconds are flagged and quarantined in mmash_rejected_windows.csv
provenance_and_quality.clinical_disclaimer: These windows represent healthy terrestrial 1g autonomic variability. They are not clinical diagnostic thresholds and must not be pooled with microgravity astronaut omics.
